hints.title: Whole String Candidate Maximization
hints.text: An uncommon subsequence will always be an entire string from the list rather than a strictly smaller substring.

hints.title: Descending Length Sorting
hints.text: Sort the string list by descending length. The first string that is not a subsequence of any other string in the list is the optimal answer.

hints.title: Subsequence Verification Helper
hints.text: Implement a helper isSubsequence(s1, s2). For candidate s[i], test against all s[j] where j does not equal i; if it is never a subsequence, return its length.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N^2 * L) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating powerset subsequences across all strings leads to exponential memory and time explosion.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Testing whole strings pairwise takes O(N^2 * L) with tiny N <= 50, running in under 2ms.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should prove why checking candidate strings in full is sufficient to find the longest uncommon subsequence.
